import {DefaultResourceLoader,SettingsManager,SessionManager,ModelRuntime,createAgentSession} from '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent';import {writeFileSync,mkdirSync} from 'node:fs';import {join} from 'node:path';
const agent=process.env.PI_AGENT_DIR,cwd=process.cwd();for(const p of [agent+'/skills/alpha',agent+'/prompts',cwd+'/.pi/skills/beta',cwd+'/.pi/prompts'])mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true});writeFileSync(agent+'/skills/alpha/SKILL.md','---

const normalized=value=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value,(key,v)=>typeof v==='string'?v.replaceAll('\','/').replaceAll(agent.replaceAll('\','/'),'<agent>').replaceAll(cwd.replaceAll('\','/'),'<cwd>'):v));const loader=new DefaultResourceLoader({cwd,agentDir:agent,noExtensions:true,noThemes:true});await loader.reload();const discovery=normalized({skills:loader.getSkills(),prompts:loader.getPrompts(),agents:loader.getAgentsFiles(),system:loader.getSystemPrompt(),systemSource:loader.getSystemPromptSource(),append:loader.getAppendSystemPrompt(),appendSources:loader.getAppendSystemPromptSources()});
